Find a Voting Location

Election Day is November 3, 2026! Make a plan to vote, and vote early if you can. Returning your ballot before Election Day speeds up results reporting, saves taxpayer dollars, and reduces calls and emails from campaigns! 

In Jeffco, we will operate 35 in-person voting centers and 40 ballot drop boxes (38 that are available 24-hours a day and two that are available during business hours).

Download a list of voting locations

  1. Vote Centers

Voter Service and Polling Centers (VSPC)

At any VSPC, you can vote, drop off your ballot, register to vote or update your voter record, request a replacement ballot, see a Spanish-language ballot, and use accessible voting equipment.

  • Stage 1 vote centers open October 19
  • Stage 2 vote centers open October 30
  • Stage 3 vote centers open November 2

In-person voting hours

  • October 19 to November 2: Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
  • October 31: Saturday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
  • November 3: Tuesday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
  • Closed Sundays

  1. Drop Boxes

Ballot Drop Boxes

You can drop your ballot off at any vote center or at a drop box near you. All our drop boxes are monitored by video and emptied regularly by bipartisan teams. You do not need postage to use a drop box. All drop boxes open October 5 and will stay open 24/7 until 7:00 p.m. on Election Day, November 3. 

All drop boxes are walk‑up boxes unless noted otherwise.
